title: OL-20261112-15: Replace ctl-workers-codeowners-human-approval
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 scripts/fleet_probe.py codeowners-removed
**Status:** closed
**Residual:** workers-codeowners-replacement

Replacement is the automated protected-path gate in workers (selfhost_check.py plus canary_revert.py). A permission-classifier refusal blocked the first attempt; the next path is a workers change authored by the executor lane.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 224.2 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
